decisions.reason: The impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY updating battery_connector_arrangement; no stale or incompatible key requires removal.
Using the USB-C connector as a placement reference does not change its type, data-line requirement, or sourceability constraints.
Relocating the battery connector does not change the battery-protection modes or cutoff requirements.
The battery connector's placement changes, but the requirement to connect the battery NTC through J_BAT remains unchanged.
Battery connector placement does not affect the SK6812 charge-status indicator, GPIO assignment, or separate-LED rule.
The connector relocation does not change boost-converter enable control, pull-down configuration, or powered-load behavior.
The source decision changes only battery connector placement and does not modify the TVS-based ESD-protection requirement.
The battery connector relocation is unrelated to I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
Changing the battery connector's board placement does not select a different component or alter any component-availability constraint.
